The first hang dump came from #645, run 36496265612 (attempt 1). Its artifact expired from GitHub on 2026-10-03, so it was preserved on this node at /Users/brianhallmanac/.hall9k/projects/hall9k/notes/ci-hang-2026-10-02/artifact/ (dotnet_2657_20260928T232154_hangdump.dmp, a minidump, and Sequence_*.xml, the test start order). Do not load the host to reproduce: no stress loops or repeated test runs to chase the flake.
